first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 shows activation messaging improved week-one engagement and nudged accounts to first meaningful action. Memory_86 shows shortened onboarding improved completion rates. Rather than reactive promotional pricing (memory_73 shows material retention risk) or referral incentives (best suited to established customers when acquisition is stable), activation_messaging addresses both simultaneous declines directly. It targets the funnel degradation without the retention risks of discounting. Memory_31 supports that onboarding friction reduction works; activation_messaging complements this by improving engagement within the corrected flow. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is valuable but addresses a different segment and wouldn't address the SMB activation decline. Verification of memory_86 and memory_91 will confirm whether these interventions remain effective and whether they can be combined or sequenced. Standard_experiment scale allows learning with acceptable risk before potential broader rollout.

final.rationale: Archive verification confirms both memory_86 (completion +13%, retention +3%) and memory_91 (engagement +11%, activation +6%, retention +1%) are reliable. Current situation shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Activation_messaging is the immediate lever: it directly addresses engagement degradation without retention risk (exp_91 showed +1% retention). Combined with the shortened onboarding from exp_86, this creates a sequenced intervention: simpler flow + better in-product prompts. This avoids promotional_pricing (memory_73 shows material retention harm) and referral_incentives (memory_57 optimized for established cohorts, not activation crisis). Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is valuable but orthogonal to SMB activation decline. Standard_experiment scale allows measurement of cumulative effect while preserving ability to iterate. Primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue is preserved: both interventions showed retention gains, not just activation lifts.
